# Hacked Website & WordPress Recovery — Global (by WebAdish LLP)

> Emergency WordPress malware removal, hacked-site recovery, blacklist cleanup, and post-incident hardening for businesses worldwide. Operated by WebAdish LLP at `hackedwebsiterecovery.com` — the global desk of a security practice that also runs a dedicated India desk at `wordpressrecovery.in` / `hackedwebsiterecovery.in`.

## Primary services

- [Emergency WordPress recovery](https://www.hackedwebsiterecovery.com/): Triage and recovery for hacked WordPress websites, any region.
- [WordPress malware removal](https://www.hackedwebsiterecovery.com/wordpress-malware-removal/): Malware cleanup, backdoor removal, and hardening.
- [Google blacklist removal](https://www.hackedwebsiterecovery.com/google-blacklist-removal/): Cleanup and reconsideration support for blacklisted websites.
- [WooCommerce hacked-store recovery](https://www.hackedwebsiterecovery.com/woocommerce-hacked-recovery/): Incident response for compromised online stores.
- [Hosting suspension recovery](https://www.hackedwebsiterecovery.com/wordpress-hosting-suspended-malware/): Cleanup for malware-related hosting suspensions.
